project: Atom Lithography Machine — Stage-2 Full 180/180 Engineering Blueprint

epistemic.statement: All 180/180 BOM parts have verified M0/M1 engineering design artifacts (CAD, KiCad 8 PCB, live ngspice-47 SPICE, electrical ICDs, Verilator/Icarus/Yosys RTL, or software/EDA manifests). None of the hardware has been fabricated, taped out, lab-measured, or certified to IEC 61508 / SEMI S2.
